purpose: Define exact AC-addressable resources and operations so authorization targets are canonical identities/addresses rather than fuzzy labels, UI positions or transport endpoints.

topics.name: AccessCore Resource Addressing
topics.purpose: Define exact AC-addressable resources and operations so authorization targets are canonical identities/addresses rather than fuzzy labels, UI positions or transport endpoints.

semantics.exact_rule: Authorization target resolves exactly through canonical identity/addressing.
semantics.subarea_rule: Expose/Editor subareas may be addressed independently.
semantics.transport_rule: URL, port, socket or route is a binding unless explicitly mapped to a canonical governed resource.
semantics.hierarchy_rule: Address hierarchy does not automatically imply inherited rights.
semantics.operation_rule: Read, write and invoke rights are evaluated against explicit target/operation semantics.

invariants.rule: AccessCore decisions are explicit policy evaluations over identity, resource and operation context; authentication assurance, visibility and ownership never silently become authorization.

hard_gates.condition: URL/port used as authorization identity without mapping
parent address automatically grants child rights without policy
operation mode omitted where policy distinguishes read/write/invoke

references.purpose: AC targets use exact canonical addressing.
